messages:
Maria Gomez: opened PR to tidy up the Troubleshooting > Error reference for 429/timeouts/context limits. Found an awkward streaming example that confuses resume vs fallback semantics. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8650
Sam Patel: I can take the link fixes and lint issues. quick question  which SDK snippets do we want to showcase for resume? v1 or v2?
Cheng Li: prefer v2 handler semantics. For the streaming case we should show both a curl repro and a minimal Python client snippet that demonstrates detecting a 429 after partial stream and either resuming (if idempotent) or doing a graceful fallback. I'll paste a curl repro.
Cheng Li: ```bash
# simulate partial stream then 429
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-light-1","input":"(very long prompt)"}'
# cut connection after first few tokens (network interrupt)
```
Lina Torres: I'll author a compact Python snippet showing context trimming + exponential backoff. Something like:
Lina Torres: ```python
# pseudo-client v2
resp = client.responses.stream(model="rwd-light-1", input=trim_prompt(prompt, max_tokens=2048))
try:
  for chunk in resp:
    handle(chunk)
except StreamError as e:
  if e.status_code == 429:
    # fallback: trim prefix, apply backoff, or switch model variant
    wait_exp_backoff(attempts)
    retry_with_trimming()
```
Sam Patel: CI flagged samples/errref/streaming-429.md: broken anchor and markdown lint. I'll push fixes and update the anchor to `#handling-429-in-streams`.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8650  build queued
Maria Gomez: also add a brief note under "Context limits" about server-side truncation: clients should check the response metadata for `truncated` flags and avoid assuming full prompt fidelity.
Cheng Li: added note in branch and included a short table comparing resume vs fallback: resume = when operation is idempotent and we have resume token; fallback = when partial output is fine or operation is non-idempotent.
Lina Torres: left TODO to reference the SDK's `retry_policy` options and a small snippet showing `max_retries:3, backoff: exponential` so users can copy-paste.
Sam Patel: pushed lint and link fixes, re-ran CI  now green.
Maria Gomez: can someone run the curl repro in a dev workspace and confirm the stream->429 behaviour reproducible? If yes, we'll merge and ship docs patch with next release.
Cheng Li: ran it, reproduced the 429-on-interrupted-stream and added a short note: prefer checking `status_code` over parsing partial JSON body in streaming errors.
Maria Gomez: perfect, merging after squash. I'll add an entry to release notes: "Docs: improved streaming 429 guidance + SDK resume examples".
Lina Torres: thanks all, closing out this thread.
